WITH linked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.abhvreg,
    tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
counted_by_mix AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM linked_data
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    record_count,
    CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(record_count) OVER () as share
  FROM counted_by_mix
),
baseline_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as baseline_share
  FROM with_shares
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.ordertypedist,
    ws.record_count,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - bc.baseline_share as above_baseline
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN baseline_calc bc
  WHERE ws.share > bc.baseline_share
)
SELECT 
  ordertypedist,
  record_count,
  share,
  above_baseline
FROM above_baseline;

assumptions.assumption: "Simple average of shares" is interpreted as the arithmetic mean (AVG function). Since shares sum to exactly 1.0, this baseline equals 1/N where N is the count of distinct ordertypedist groups.
NULL values in ordertypedist are treated as a separate group (standard SQL GROUP BY behavior) and are included in both the count calculation and baseline averaging.
